'''Imperial chic'''<ref name="Union 3">[[Union 3|''Union'' 3]]</ref> or '''Imp-chic''' was a clothing style promoted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It resulted in dull gray clothing being considered fashionable.<ref name="Union 2">[[Union 2|''Union'' 2]]</ref>
